body:
Done. Edited `src/styles/global.css` only. Changes:

1. **Removed Inter font** (line 15): `--font-sans` now `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif`. `--font-mono` unchanged.

2. **Added focus-visible styles** in `@layer base` (after `input, textarea` block, ~line 84): covers `a`, `button`, `input`, `textarea`, `select`, `[tabindex]` — `outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px;`

3. **Added `prefers-reduced-motion` media query** after `@layer base` closing brace (~line 93): sets `animation-duration`, `animation-iteration-count`, `transition-duration` to `0.01ms !important`, `scroll-behavior: auto !important` on `*, *::before, *::after`.

4. **Deleted `.text-gradient`** class from `@layer components`.

5. **Deleted `.grid-bg`** class from `@layer components`.

6. **Deleted `.noise-bg`** class and its `::before` pseudo-element noise pattern from `@layer components`.

All color tokens, easing tokens, scrollbar styles, selection styles, base resets preserved. No other files touched.
